trophies.guide: The hardest trophy and the first gold of the set. After the story, a 100% Completion checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. It is far more forgiving than it sounds — closer to 60% true completion: most side quests are not needed, collectibles are only partly required, and you need any 70 of 80 challenges. The parts that do need everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing toward 100% is missable. Do any 100 optional missions, scan 200 of 277 base vehicles, study 100 of 255 animals, finish 300 stunts, and work the checklist after the story. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide and 100% checklist; Exophase trophy list.
trophies.name: A Long Road
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 100% Completion Checklist & Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in four kinds: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. You can mix kinds — under-the-bridge runs are the quickest. Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots. The 100% checklist needs 300 stunts, so keep going past this one. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide; Exophase trophy list.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: The tracker counts 9 activity types: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / drone race, and performing a stunt. Open Progress > Activities to see them, and filter the map for Activities (blue dumbbell icon). You will do one of each naturally while working on the other trophies, so this usually pops on its own. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide; Exophase trophy list.

You need a gold medal in every challenge — the gold medals are not too hard, and Focus levels up by playing the ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, which makes later attempts easier. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide and shooting range guide; Exophase trophy list.

To complete a game, finish all its levels at least once — you do not need every challenge. Pick whichever you like best.
